title: The Quilt Raffle
story: Hattie hung four quilts across the church hall stage for the fall raffle, each a year's work by the sewing circle. Four hopefuls bought tickets, each for a different quilt and with a different room already picked out for it. Wren, for one, whispers that she has measured twice. Before the drawing, Hattie wants every stub checked against her list. Who entered for which quilt, how many tickets did each buy, and which room did each have in mind?

texts: Of the entrant with 2 tickets and the entrant with 4 tickets, one entered for the star quilt and the other entered for the nine patch quilt.
The entrant for the nine patch quilt bought exactly 2 more tickets than the entrant with the bedroom in mind.
The entrant for the nine patch quilt bought fewer tickets than the entrant with the porch in mind.
Jade entered for either the nine patch or the wedding ring quilt.
Emil bought exactly 4 tickets fewer than the entrant with the den in mind.
Pablo bought more tickets than the entrant with the porch in mind.
